name: isometric wipers
description: From the bottom of a wide push-up, you shift your body from one hand to the other without coming up. It works the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Get into a push-up position with your hands wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest until it is just above the floor.
Stay low and shift your body toward one hand.
Slide across to the other hand without pushing up.
Keep your body straight and your core tight the whole time.
